info.title: Itential Platform - Lifecycle Manager
info.description: Itential Platform's own Lifecycle Manager REST API: resource models, resource instances, resource actions/action-executions, and instance groups. Lets one Itential Platform (or Itential Gateway) automate network-service lifecycle management -- modeling a service, then creating/updating/deleting instances of it by running model-defined actions -- against another Itential Platform instance, or itself.
info.x-itential-curated: Hand-authored from Itential's own published per-operation API reference (docs.itential.com/itential-platform/6/6/api-reference/lifecycle-manager); no downloadable spec or navigable index page exists for this category, so the full slug list was recovered via the docs site's own 404-page suggestions. Covers all 22 confirmed Lifecycle Manager operations across Resource Models, Resource Instances, Actions/Action Executions, and Instance Groups -- the full real surface, not a curated subset. Resource instance lifecycle (create/update/delete) has no direct REST endpoints; it happens exclusively by running a model-defined action of that type via run-action/run-bulk-action.

instance.description: instance id, to run an update/delete action against an existing instance

apiKeyAuth.name: token
apiKeyAuth.description: Token obtained from POST /login using a username/password body. Itential Platform automates the retrieval and injects it as the 'token' query parameter on every request. The response body is the bare token string itself (no JSON envelope), so no responsePointer is set.
